steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Define unique app name 'Uniq' and target package 'com.uniq.app' within app-meta.json for standard deployment.

steps.title: Setup Build Configuration
steps.description: Configure build.gradle with proper Android SDK (34) compliance, Java 17 compatibility environment, and dependencies-free build target.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Declare AndroidManifest.xml, matching packaging, launcher configurations, and system Theme.Material.Light settings.

steps.title: Design App Colors & Theme resources
steps.description: Set up clean material styling, colors, margins, and branding specifications in values assets.

steps.title: Build Main Interface Layout
steps.description: Create a fully functional multi-tab interactive layout inside activity_main.xml including Deduplicator, Comparison Diff, and Generator components.

steps.title: Develop Tab Handling System
steps.description: Program custom tab state toggling dynamically between modules (Deduplicate, List Compare, and Unique Generator) using clean View state alterations.

steps.title: Implement Deduplicator Engine
steps.description: Code string tokenizer, case-insensitive mapping, item trimming, alpha/numeric sorting, and duplication frequencies calculation.

steps.title: Implement List Comparison Diff Engine
steps.description: Create high-performance algorithms to identify unique entities from List A, unique entities from List B, common items, and general union.

steps.title: Implement Unique Random Generator
steps.description: Construct randomized password, character key, and bounded number generation logics maintaining zero repetitions.

steps.title: Integrate System Clipboard and Share Intent Services
steps.description: Allow copying outputs to standard device clipboard with notifications and native sharing of filtered results.

steps.title: Validation and Code Cleanup
steps.description: Strict compliance validation with Java 8 limitations, verifying omission of stream APIs, lambda functions, or external packages.

steps.title: Building Uniq
steps.description: Execute native Android Gradle compiler system to build high-performance clean application.
